messages:
rita: Heads-up from today's quant-canary: vanguard-int8 produced a partial funcall then stream cut; runtime retried and we saw duplicate side-effects in staging. Low frequency but serious for payments.

maria: can you paste the minimal trace?

rita: sure:
```
chunk1: '{\"action\": \"call\", \"name\": \"charge\", \"args\": {\"amount\": 50'
chunk2: ', \"currency\": \"USD\"}}'
chunk3: <lost EOS>
parser: EOFError
runtime: immediate retry -> model returns full funcall -> downstream charged twice
```

ashley: two short-term mitigations: (A) short quiesce window on parse-EOF (wait T ms before auto-retry), (B) parser emits persistent partial_funccall flag when it sees top-level action==call + name present; if flag set, suppress auto-retry and surface structured error so orchestration can decide idempotency.

maria: +1. For quiesce, derive T from chunk_gap p95/p99. telemetry?

telemetry-bot: vanguard-canary chunk_gap_ms p50=21 p95=110 p99=260 (48h).

maria: ok start with quiesce candidates 150ms and 300ms for A/B. Implement both and run canary traffic with synthetic tail-frame-drop injection.

rita: eval plan: 10k streaming requests, inject tail-frame-drop at 0.6% of traces, compare baseline vs quiesce-150 vs quiesce-300 vs parser-flag-only. Track duplicate_toolcalls_per_100k, parse_fail_rate, added_latency_p95.

ashley: implementation notes: parser will emit event "partial_funccall" with minimal metadata (name, seen_arg_keys) rather than blocking. Runtime will set RequestState.partial_funccall=true and consult retry scheduler. Also add trace fields: partial_funccall, retry_suppressed_by_flag, quiesce_ms.

maria: important policy: if partial_funccall==true we MUST NOT auto-retry by default for non-idempotent routes. For Dedicated customers allow config toggle (retry_policy.non_idempotent=false).

infra-bot: provisioned: vanguard-int8-canary-1, 180rps.

maria: owners?

rita: i'll own canary harness + synthetic injector.

ashley: parser changes + fuzz harness, will PR today.

maria: i'll write RFC with signal matrix and acceptance: reduce duplicates by >=85% on injected tail-drop test, parse-fail regression <0.05%, latency p95 impact <6% for quiesce-150.

rita: thanks. tagging integrations team about downstream idempotency risk. :thumbsup:
